description: Registry of all capabilities in the ManiPsych AdIntel system. Each capability records its user problem, producer, consumers, route, status, and target state.

capabilities.name: Corpus overview / Mission Control
capabilities.user_problem: User needs to understand the full data, annotation, model, and analysis architecture at a glance
capabilities.status: FRAGMENTED — current #metrics is a flat KPI grid, not a mission control
capabilities.target_state: Consolidated Mission Control with product purpose, corpus overview, provenance, model status, task entry points, headline findings

capabilities.name: Analyze an Ad (text input + assessment)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to paste ad copy and get a technically honest assessment
capabilities.status: DISCONNECTED — not integrated into the main dashboard
capabilities.target_state: Integrated 'Analyze an Ad' workspace in the main dashboard with text + image upload, honest execution modes, evidence spans, checkpoint provenance

capabilities.name: Explore Evidence (corpus search, ad inspection)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to explore the corpus, inspect individual ads, understand techniques
capabilities.status: FRAGMENTED — three separate explorers (Top 25, ad selector, full table) with no unified search
capabilities.target_state: Unified 'Explore Evidence' section with corpus search, ad-level inspection, technique prevalence, term networks, profiles, clusters, outliers, authorship, visual analysis

capabilities.name: Clustering and cluster explanation
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand why an ad belongs to a cluster and see distinguishing features
capabilities.status: ACTIVE — Solarize Round 1-4 improved this significantly
capabilities.target_state: Part of unified 'Explore Evidence' section with deeper drill-down

capabilities.name: Outlier analysis (4-way classification + term comparison)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand what makes outlier ads different and see honest non-difference verdicts

capabilities.name: Authorship / common-source analysis
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to know if two ads came from the same creative source
capabilities.status: ACTIVE — Solarize Round 3 made it data-driven

capabilities.name: Persuasive profile (17 dimensions)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to see how intensely each ad uses 17 persuasion dimensions
capabilities.status: ACTIVE — Solarize Round 3 made Key Insights data-driven
capabilities.target_state: Part of unified 'Explore Evidence' section + integrated with ad grader

capabilities.name: Corpus map (2D scatter)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to see the corpus landscape and click points to inspect ads
capabilities.status: ACTIVE — Solarize Round 4 fixed broken controls + added interactivity

capabilities.name: Adversarial generation loop (SUSPECTED MISLABELING)
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand how adversarial examples improve detector robustness
capabilities.status: SUSPECTED: phrase injection + regex mutation mislabeled as 'GAN'. Needs forensic verification in Round 1.
capabilities.target_state: If confirmed: rename to 'Rule-Based Adversarial Sandbox' or 'Adversarial Phrase Perturbation Prototype'. Integrate into 'Models & Adversarial Lab' section.

capabilities.name: Model registry + checkpoint registry
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to know what models exist, their calibration status, and deployment eligibility
outputs: checkpoint table with version, calibration, cost, latency, abstention conditions
capabilities.target_state: Part of unified 'Models & Adversarial Lab' section with calibration evidence, failure slices, deployment eligibility

capabilities.name: Methodology documentation
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand why each statistical choice was made
capabilities.target_state: Part of unified 'Guide, Methods & Audit' section

capabilities.name: Audit evidence
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to verify deployment claims are auditable
outputs: #adintel-audit section with Red phase, Green phase, verification rounds
capabilities.target_state: Part of unified 'Guide, Methods & Audit' section

capabilities.name: Interactive tutorial
capabilities.user_problem: User wants a guided walkthrough of the system
capabilities.target_state: Restartable interactive tutorial with 6 modes, event-driven advancement, local persistence, pause/resume/restart

capabilities.name: Ask AdIntel contextual assistant
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to ask questions about loaded evidence
capabilities.target_state: Local evidence assistant using loaded structured result + canonical indicator definitions + deterministic templates

capabilities.name: Indicator dictionary
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand the formula, denominator, thresholds, and limitations of every visible indicator
capabilities.status: MISSING — no canonical indicator dictionary exists
capabilities.target_state: Canonical definition for every visible indicator with formula, numerator, denominator, unit, valid range, thresholds, provenance, failure modes, worked example

capabilities.name: Connected pipeline diagram
capabilities.user_problem: User wants to understand the full collection → annotation → model → analysis → feedback pipeline
capabilities.status: STATIC — current pipeline is a flat SVG, not interactive, AdIntel is placed BESIDE the pipeline rather than INSIDE it
capabilities.target_state: Interactive pipeline with 41 nodes, each selectable, showing purpose/inputs/outputs/implementation/status/limitations
